Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.

After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with %punch_attack_range% range with bonus movement speed.

Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills.

The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
Lion's disfigured hand is also the source of his greatest power, capable of flooding victims with malefic force.
Finger of Death has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within %grace_period% seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.
Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_lion_bio: Once a Grandmaster of the Demon Witch tradition of sorcery, Lion earned fame among his brethren for fighting on the side of light and righteousness. But adulation corrupts. With powers surpassed only by his ambition, the mage was seduced by a demon and turned to evil, trading his soul for prestige. After committing horrible crimes that marred his soul, he was abandoned. The demon betrayed him, striking better deals with his enemies. Such was Lion's rage that he followed the demon back to hell and slew it, ripping it limb from limb, taking its demonic hand for his own. However, such demonoplasty comes at a cost. Lion was transfigured by the process, his body transformed into something unrecognizable. He rose from hell, rage incarnate, slaying even those who had once called him master, and laying waste to the lands where he had once been so adored. He survives now as the sole practitioner of the Demon Witch tradition, and those who present themselves as acolytes or students are soon relieved of their mana and carried off by the faintest gust of wind.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_lion_hype: Lion gives enemies little chance to retaliate. Stunning targets with a damaging row of spikes, or temporarily transforming them into a harmless critter, even if his powerful spells aren't enough, he and his allies should still have all the time they need to slay their foes.

* This ability has three main components.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Projectile|Link}}
*** Can only be cast on units that have {{M|mana}}.
*** The primary link does not break in the following conditions:
**** When the affected enemy unit runs out of mana.
**** The link still affects the unit if they are {{M|untargetable}} after being affected by Mana Drain.
**** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
***** Visually draws to where the affected enemy unit was under {{M|vision}} previously.
*** {{cf|shdnotes}} Now affects {{ValueColor||{{#var:Mana Drain type3 value1 shd}}|shd}} additional random enemy units, prioritizing heroes, within {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Mana Drain cast range}}+{{#var:Mana Drain type3 value2 shd}}}}|shd}} radius, centered around Lion.
**** [[File:Dota2 Lion Mana Drain Mult-1 icon.png|84px|Mana Drain Secondary Targets]] with {{hi|Lion}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]]
***** If the primary unit-targeted unit is an ally [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] , Mana Drain searches for {{ValueColor||{{#var:Mana Drain type3 value1 shd}}|shd}} secondary enemy units within the search radius.
**** [[File:Dota2 Lion Mana Drain Mult-2 icon.png|84px|Mana Drain Secondary Targets]] with {{hi|Lion}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-f.png|21px|F]]
***** If the primary unit-targeted unit is an enemy, allied units will not be valid secondary targets within the search radius.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Projectile|Linkbreak}}
*** The link breaks in the following interactions with the primary {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} targeted unit:
**** Upon its {{M|death}}.
**** When no longer within Lion's {{M|vision}} radius.
**** Upon exceeding the link break distance.
***** The effective area for the link break distance is a half-[[wikipedia:sphere|sphere]] [[File:Dota2 Area Half-Circle Bottom icon.png|20px|Area-of-effect visualized.]] and not a flat circle. Hence, the link can be broken with {{M|upward movement}} sources as well.
**** When the primary {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} targeted unit is affected by the following sources:
***** {{M|Hidden}}
***** {{M|Invulnerability}}
***** {{M|Spell Immunity}}
**** {{cf|shdnotes}} The link breaks for secondary units upon the {{M|channeling}} component on the primary targeted unit being interrupted in any way, except when the primary unit exceeding the link break distance.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|3|21px]] {{Symbol|Channeling|t}}
*** All ability effects are applied in {{#var:Mana Drain basic1}}-second intervals, as long as the [[channeling]] component is active, starting {{#var:Mana Drain basic1}} seconds after cast, over a max {{#expr:{{#var:Mana Drain value3}}/{{#var:Mana Drain basic1}}}} instances.
*** For {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|Channeling}}
**** {{Symbol|bonus mprestore}}
***** Applies {{calc|v1*{{#var:Mana Drain basic1}}|v1={{#var:Mana Drain value4}}}} [[mana restore]] per interval.
***** The mana restore value corresponds to the total mana removed from {{ValueColor||all|shd}} affected enemy unit(s). Hence, if the affected unit has no mana left, the ability does not continue replenishing Lion's mana.
**** {{cf|shdnotes}} Grants {{M|debuff immunity}} without applying {{M|basic dispel}} while active.
***** Stacks multiplicatively with other {{M|magic resistance}} sources.
*** For {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** Applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|lion_mana_drain}} on {{ValueColor||all|shd}} affected enemy units:
****# Grants {{M|True Sight}} over the unit.
****#* Hence, the ability still fully affects the unit if it becomes {{M|invisible}}.
****# Removes {{calc|v1*{{#var:Mana Drain basic1}}|v1={{#var:Mana Drain value4}}}} {{M|mana}} per interval.
****# The {{M|movement speed}} slow.
*** For {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
**** Applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|lion_mana_drain}} on the affected enemy unit:
***** Grants {{calc|v1*{{#var:Mana Drain basic1}}|v1={{#var:Mana Drain type2 value1}}}} {{M|mana restore}} per interval.
***** The {{M|movement speed}} bonus.
**** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}}
***** Lion loses {{calc|v1*{{#var:Mana Drain basic1}}|v1={{#var:Mana Drain value4}}}} {{M|mana}} per interval.
***** The allied unit's {{M|mana restore}} value corresponds to Lion's mana loss value, with other ability notes apply.
***** {{Symbol|Illusions}}
****** Applies the mana restore component on allied [[illusions]].

* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
*** When unit-targeted, applies all ability effects on the enemy unit.
** {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-1.png|84px]]
*** {{cf|aghnotes}} The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} changes the ability targeting functionality from {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted to {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}} {{ValueColor||unit and area-targeted|agh}}.
**** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Finger of Death cast range}}+{{#var:Finger of Death type3 value1 agh}}}}|agh}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
**** Applies all ability effects to all enemy units within the radius, centered around the unit-targeted enemy.
**** Affects the following units within the radius:
***** {{M|Fogged units}}.
***** {{M|Invisible}} units.

* This ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** The ability effects are applied as follows:
***# Applies a {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|lion_finger_of_death}} {{#var:Finger of Death value1}}-second debuff on the affected enemy unit.
***#* Reapplying the debuff refreshes its duration.
***# Applies the {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} once the {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|lion_finger_of_death}} is {{Symbol|Dispel|Death}} [[dispelled]] in any way.
***#* Hence, the spell damage component can be avoided with the following sources:
***#** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
***#** {{M|Invulnerable}} sources.
***#** {{M|Spell immune}} sources.
***#* The spell damage is defined as:
***#** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|{{#var:Finger of Death value2}} + {{ValueColor||100|agh|x}} + ({{#var:Finger of Death type1 value3}} + {{ValueColor||{{Show|T|Lion|v3r}}|tal|x}}) × f(Stack)}}
***# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|lion_finger_of_death_delay}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|lion_finger_of_death_kill_counter}}
***#* This ability component is the {{#var:Finger of Death type1 value1}}-second kill grace duration.
***#* Grants a stack as the debuff-affected enemy hero(es) dies, including {{M|reincarnation}} sources, while having the second debuff in any way.
***#** Lion does not need to be credited for the {{M|death}}.
***#* Considers the following units as heroes:
***#** The {{H|Spirit Bear}}.
***#** {{A|Meepo|Meepo Clones}} grants one stack regardless the number of debuffs applied.
***#* Consider {{M|The Double}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
***#* Reapplying the debuff refreshes its duration.
***#* {{Symbol|Modifier|Stack}}
***#** {{A|Meepo|Meepo Clones}} grants one stack regardless the number of debuffs applied.
***#** The {{H|Spirit Bear}} grants one stack.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|lion_finger_of_death_kill_counter}}
**** Grants the {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} increase per stack.
***** {{cf|talnotes}} Learning the {{ValueColor||spell damage bonus increasing|20tal}} {{M|talent|t=t3r}} grants the bonuses retroactively.

**** Upon its {{M|death}}.
**** When no longer within Lion's {{M|vision}} radius.
**** Upon exceeding the link break distance.

***** {{M|Invulnerability}}
***** {{M|Spell Immunity}}

***#* Consider {{M|The Double}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
***#* Reapplying the debuff refreshes its duration.
***#* {{Symbol|Modifier|Stack}}
***#** {{A|Meepo|Meepo Clones}} grants one stack regardless the number of debuffs applied.
***#** The {{H|Spirit Bear}} grants one stack.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|lion_finger_of_death_kill_counter}}
**** Grants the {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} increase per stack.
***** {{cf|talnotes}} Learning the {{ValueColor||spell damage bonus increasing|20tal}} {{M|talent|t=t3r}} grants the bonuses retroactively.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_lion
data.bio_loc: Once a Grandmaster of the Demon Witch tradition of sorcery, Lion earned fame among his brethren for fighting on the side of light and righteousness. But adulation corrupts. With powers surpassed only by his ambition, the mage was seduced by a demon and turned to evil, trading his soul for prestige. After committing horrible crimes that marred his soul, he was abandoned. The demon betrayed him, striking better deals with his enemies. Such was Lion's rage that he followed the demon back to hell and slew it, ripping it limb from limb, taking its demonic hand for his own. However, such demonoplasty comes at a cost. Lion was transfigured by the process, his body transformed into something unrecognizable. He rose from hell, rage incarnate, slaying even those who had once called him master, and laying waste to the lands where he had once been so adored. He survives now as the sole practitioner of the Demon Witch tradition, and those who present themselves as acolytes or students are soon relieved of their mana and carried off by the faintest gust of wind.
data.hype_loc: Lion gives enemies little chance to retaliate. Stunning targets with a damaging row of spikes, or temporarily transforming them into a harmless critter, even if his powerful spells aren't enough, he and his allies should still have all the time they need to slay their foes.
